newsitem.title: USA: Lucent hits high as Q4 EPS beat expectations.
newsitem.headline: Lucent hits high as Q4 EPS beat expectations.

text.p: Shares in Lucent Technologies Inc set a new high of 49-3/4, up 1-3/8, in early trading on Thursday after fiscal fourth quarter proforma earnings per share substantially exceeded analysts' consensus forecasts.
Earnings per share for the quarter were $0.40, compared with $0.02 a year ago when the company was part of AT&T Corp. First Call's consensus for the quarter was $0.37.

"There was strong growth in revenue across the quarter," said analyst Walter Piecyk of Paine Webber. However he said that a change in the fiscal year-end to end September from December may have led to some pulling forward of revenues.
"Our outlook has not changed given that some revenues were probably pulled forward from the December quarter," he said.
Piecyk noted that the stock's strong run since it was offered to underwriters at $27 in April's IPO had put the shares at a price-to-earnings ratio premium to the sector.
However he was satisfied that costs were kept under control as part of the re-engineering of the company, while sales pulled ahead.
"It (revenue growth) is probably helped by the stronger relationship with the regional Bells following the split off from AT&T," Piecyk said.

One rationale for AT&T splitting off Lucent was that regional Bells, big buyers of complex network equipment, had become increasingly reluctant to shop at AT&T when it was soon to be a competitor in a unified telephone services market.
Lucent finally became an independent company on September 30 when AT&T parcelled out its remaining 82.4 stake in the company to shareholders.
